name: icon-toggle
title: Icon Toggle
description: A two-state icon button that morphs its SVG paths on every click.

useCases: Icon toggles with a reversible morph between two states, such as menu and close or play and pause.
limitations: Custom path pairs must use matching SVG commands and coordinate counts in a 24 by 24 viewBox. Uses rounded strokes with no fill. Does not morph arbitrary React icon components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and the shared UI Button. Supply a stable accessible label. Controlled usage requires updating pressed in onPressedChange. Reduced motion switches paths instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/icon-toggle.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
